idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before idle users are logged out. Set to 0 to disable automatic logout.

grace_period.description: Seconds before logout during which the user can extend their session (e.g., by moving mouse or typing).

enabled.description: Whether the idle logout daemon is active. Set to false to pause enforcement.

exclude_users.description: List of usernames that should never be logged out automatically.

items.description: Username to exclude from idle logout.

protected_sessions.description: Session types that should be protected from idle logout even if idle.

items.description: Allowed session type (e.g., ssh, vnc, x11, wayland).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log to syslog instead.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: debug, info, warn, error.

extended_tracking.description: Enable fine-grained input tracking (mouse/keyboard) to delay logout.

services.description: Custom timeout overrides for specific session services.

timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds for this service, overriding global timeout.
